title: browser sound routed through the mixer, behind its own switch (manual until automated)

clauses.text: With the mixer on and the browser switch on, the browser's sound plays through IYAKKI's mixer and the row says carrying.

steps.do: As an administrator, open Settings, Sound, turn the mixer on, then turn on Browser sound through the mixer (experimental).
steps.expect: The row says it applies the next time the web engine starts.

steps.do: Start the web engine (open a web page in the browser) and play a page with sound.
steps.expect: The page's sound comes from the speakers and the row says carrying.

clauses.text: With the switch off, the browser opens the sound card itself again from the next web engine start.

steps.do: Turn the browser switch off, restart the web engine and play sound.
steps.expect: Sound still plays. The row says the browser opens the sound card itself again from the next web engine start.

clauses.text: With the mixer off the switch does nothing, and the row says so.

steps.do: Turn the mixer off while the browser switch is on, and read the row.
steps.expect: The row says: Browser sound through the mixer on, but it does nothing until the mixer above is on.

clauses.text: Only administrators change the switch; everybody may read the row.

steps.do: Sign in as a person who is not an administrator and open Settings, Sound.
steps.expect: The switch cannot be changed by that person: the change is refused or not offered, and the page says why in words.
